facets.statement: Bir kişinin geceyi kötü bir durumda geçirmesi çekirdek kullanımdır.
Deyişteki durum adı olma kökünden yapılmış bir biçim olarak açıklanır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deyişi akıcı Türkçe cümle içinde karşılamak için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Geceyi kötü durumda geçirme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Geceleme ayrıntısı bağlamdan belliyse daha kısa karşılık olarak kullanılabilir.

error_profile.loses: Geceyi geçirme koşulunu açıkça söylemez.
error_profile.preserves: Kötü durumda bulunma yönünü korur.

error_profile.adds: Deyişe bağlı gece geçirme sınırının dışına taşan genel sıkıntı alanını getirir.
error_profile.collision: Kötü olay ve afet komşularıyla karışır.
error_profile.preserves: Kötülük ve sıkıntı çağrışımını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız kötü durum içinde gece geçirme deyişiyle sınırlıdır; genel hal veya bela adı değildir.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı, dalı belirli kötü-durum deyişiyle sınırlar ve kullanılan durum adını olma kökünden kurulmuş sayar. Bu nedenle anlam genel kötü hal adı ya da genel olma dalı değildir; geceyi kötü durumda geçirme sözünde kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bağlı söz verdiği için tanım yalnız bu deyişe bağlı kalır ve yalın kök anlamına genişlemez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Adayların hepsi kontrol edildi; yayımlananlar kötü durum deyişiyle genel kötü hal komşularını ayırır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Bu dal tek bir kötü-durum deyişine bağlıdır. Kaynak anlatımı, kişinin geceyi kötü bir durumda geçirmesini ve deyişteki durum adının olma kökünden açıklanmasını birlikte verir.

source_details.summary: Tek kaynak bildirimi kullanımı kötü durumda gece geçirme deyişiyle sınırlar.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök kümesi, olma ve bulunma çevresinden yer, konum değeri, birini üstlenme, boyun eğme, yaşlılık nitelemesi ve kötü durum adı gibi ayrışmış dallar kurar.

text.arabic_uthmani: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًۭا

baseline.text: Rabbin, lütfundan pay arayasınız diye gemileri sizin için denizde yürütendir. O size gerçekten merhametlidir.

findings.text: Gemilerin denizde yumuşakça yürütülmesi, sınırlı insanı geniş ve kararsız bir ortamda rızık arayabilecek halde taşıyan maddi bir merhamet biçimidir.

activation_trace.role: Repairing, nurturing, and completing supplies the governing care that orders the transport-and-provision chain.
The split root's feeding-and-growth image makes livelihood and developed capacity part of Lordship.
Gentle driving supplies the controlled causal motion that makes the crossing usable for people.
The water-going vessel supplies the bounded carrier through which divine enabling becomes practical.
The broad mass of water supplies the difficult medium across which the carrier is advanced.
Active seeking assigns humans a real task inside, rather than outside, the enabled chain.
Unobligated giving identifies the sought outcome as benefaction rather than autonomous acquisition.
Mercy's temporal presence presents the arrangement as an established divine way of being toward the addressees.
Tenderness expressed as beneficent action names the motive and quality of the entire chain.

changed_reading.after: The verse stages a coordinated mercy-system in which rule, gentle motion, a carrier, human effort, and gifted yield remain distinct but causally joined.
changed_reading.before: The verse reports that God moves ships so people can obtain goods.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ... رَحِيمًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship operates as a causal chain: nurturing sovereignty gently advances a vessel through a vast medium, enabling rather than replacing human seeking; the gain remains an unowed gift, and mercy names the whole arrangement.

activation_trace.role: Gentle propulsion supplies calibration rather than violent conquest of the medium.
The ship supplies a finite carrier whose usefulness depends on being moved through water.
The root's wave image of disturbed back-and-forth motion supplies the instability being managed.
Width and expansiveness make the sea a field too large for the travelers to control directly.
Active tenderness is rendered materially as safe, measured passage through instability.

changed_reading.after: Mercy is the maintained relation between a fragile carrier, a mobile expanse, and controlled forward passage.
changed_reading.before: The sea is merely the location of transport.

baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded vessel is gently driven within a wide and oscillating medium. Traversability comes from calibrated motion, not from mastering or eliminating the sea's instability.

activation_trace.role: Getting through time on little supplies the image of finite means being kept in motion.
Seeking turns mere endurance into directed effort toward provision.
Remainder beyond need supplies the surplus toward which limited means are directed.
Beneficent tenderness makes sustained passage from little toward surplus a mercy reading.

changed_reading.after: The voyage can also figure mercy as keeping scant means viable long enough to reach a divinely opened surplus.
changed_reading.before: The voyage begins from adequate resources and aims at greater wealth.

baseline_models.mechanism: The root inventory connects eking out days with little to فضل as remainder or surplus: mercy may consist in making limited means pass far enough for people to seek what exceeds present sufficiency.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and command identify the true governor of the focus movement.
Gentle driving supplies the constructive mode of mobilization.
A real gift supplies the destination opposed to deceptive promise.
Lowering and submission supply the rejected relation from which the counter-campaign begins.
Following supplies the human attachment through which the rival movement gathers participants.
Lightness that shakes stability supplies an agitating propulsion opposite gentle driving.
Driving and hauling from place to place supply the rival campaign's coercive logistics.
A glittering appearance that does not hold supplies the false yield promised by the rival system.

changed_reading.after: The focus movement is one of two competing ways humans are carried: calibrated lordly enabling toward real bounty versus destabilizing recruitment toward an appearance that fails.
changed_reading.before: The ship movement is a neutral convenience.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pre-focus sequence builds a rival logistics: refusal of submission becomes recruitment, destabilizing agitation, marshaling, and deceptive promise. Against it, the Lord's gentle driving moves people toward real bounty rather than glittering nonfulfillment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejected submission, following, agitation, marshaling, deceptive promise, gentle driving, and gift; I infer that these form rival logistics. A live alternative is a general allegiance contrast in which motion is not the organizing axis.
structural_cues: 17:61-64 progresses from refused prostration through threatened capture of descendants and followers to mobilization by voice, cavalry, wealth, children, and promises.

activation_trace.role: Careful governance supplies the identity whose sufficiency is enacted in navigation.
Gentle driving is the concrete act by which entrusted care becomes visible.
Taking up an affair until it is sufficient supplies the adequacy of divine guardianship.
The repeated nurturing Lord-title links the abstract guarantee directly to the focus actor.
One who stands over an affair with sufficient preservation supplies the guardian function realized by ship movement.

changed_reading.after: The transport is an observable enactment of entrusted, sufficient guardianship: preserving agency appears as managed passage.
changed_reading.before: Lordship is the source of a transport benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding declaration that the Lord suffices as a preserving agent is performed concretely in the focus: He takes charge of passage by gently moving the carrier for the addressees.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficiency, the preserving agent, repeated Lordship, and gentle driving; I infer that the voyage exemplifies the prior guardianship claim. The alternative is that adjacency only changes topic from protection to provision.
structural_cues: 17:65 ends with بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًا and 17:66 opens with رَّبُّكُمُ, making the title an immediate lexical hinge.

activation_trace.role: Gentle ordinary movement supplies mercy before danger becomes perceptible.
Beneficent tenderness names both unobtrusive conveyance and the rescue sequence that follows.
Harm as loss opposite benefit reveals what the prior gentle passage had been withholding.
The repeated wide water holds ordinary provision and emergency in one physical field.
Release by separation supplies the dramatic form of the same preserving mercy.
Turning one's side away supplies the human reversal after rescue.
Covering a benefit supplies the diagnosis of why routine mercy can disappear from awareness.

changed_reading.after: Mercy is already active in uneventful motion; crisis only makes visible the preservation that routine use had allowed travelers to overlook and later cover.
changed_reading.before: Mercy is inferred from successful access to bounty.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah repeats the sea and the addressees but exposes danger, exclusive appeal, extraction to land, turning away, and covered gratitude. This revises mercy from a pleasant closing attribute into a continuum spanning ordinary propulsion and emergency rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one sea, ordinary gentle movement, later harm, rescue, and concealment of benefit; I infer a single mercy continuum. A live alternative confines mercy in 17:66 to provision and treats rescue as a separate act.
structural_cues: 17:66-67 repeats second-person plural objects and the sea, then moves from enabled seeking to harm, exclusive appeal, rescue, landfall, and refusal.

activation_trace.role: Gentle driving supplies the merciful mode whose opposite remains possible.
The ship supplies the shared object exposed to either controlled passage or destructive reversal.
Heart-resting security supplies the assumption explicitly placed under question.
Dispatch and release supply a second command over movement, now directed against the travelers.
Rapid breaking supplies the destructive manner opposed to gentle propulsion.
Wind and moving air supply the physical agency through which motion can be reversed.
Submersion supplies the terminal alternative to carriage across water.

changed_reading.after: Navigable motion is a mercifully selected direction within reversible conditions; the same domain can carry, break, or engulf.
changed_reading.before: The sea is a stable commercial route and ship movement follows its normal conditions.

context_deltas.mechanism: Security is challenged on land and on a return to sea; sending can arrive as a shattering wind and drowning. Gentle propulsion is therefore not an intrinsic property of the sea but one selected mode within sovereign control of motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle driving, later sending, shattering wind, and drowning in the same sea domain; I infer a shared control-of-motion axis. The alternative treats the later threat solely as sanction without reflecting back on how 17:66 defines mercy.
structural_cues: 17:68 questions security on dry land, while 17:69 questions security upon being returned to sea, preventing either domain from functioning as an autonomous refuge.

activation_trace.role: Seeking supplies human initiative within the larger structure of bestowed capacity.
Gift beyond obligation supplies the object of seeking and links it to the later explicit preference.
Honored nobility supplies the status of the humans for whom transport is arranged.
Bearing a visible load generalizes the focus ship into a land-and-sea carriage system.
An allotted gift supplies prior provision beneath what travelers themselves seek.
Goodness opposed to corruption qualifies the provision's kind, not merely its quantity.
Degree and preference extend فضل from sought bounty to bestowed human distinction.

changed_reading.after: Their acquisition is a dignity-bearing activity made possible by prior carriage, allotment, and good provision; they act, but their agency is itself carried.
changed_reading.before: People use divine transport to acquire provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following declaration of human honor, carriage on land and sea, allotted provision, good things, and preference nests the focus's active seeking inside prior dignity and support. Human enterprise is real but already carried.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seeking in 17:66 and prior honor, carriage, provision, and preference in 17:70; I infer nested agency in which seeking operates inside endowment. The alternative reads the two ayat as separate examples in a list of favors.
structural_cues: 17:70 repeats both land/sea transport and ف ض ل after the focus, but changes the grammatical emphasis from people seeking to God honoring, carrying, providing, and preferring.

activation_trace.role: The vessel supplies outward carriage through a physical route.
Gentle forward motion supplies material progress that need not equal moral direction.
A leader who is followed supplies the organizing orientation by which groups are summoned.
Reading and recitation supply accountable recognition of one's record.
Blindness of insight supplies failure of inward navigation despite available outward movement.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the failed moral trajectory.
An extended traversable path supplies the explicit route image against which lostness is measured.

changed_reading.after: Mercy can secure outward mobility and economic opportunity without cancelling the traveler's responsibility for sight, allegiance, and moral route.
changed_reading.before: Merciful transport implies a successful passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence moves from physical carriage to communities oriented by an imam and a readable record, then to blindness and a more-lost path. This separates successful outward conveyance from inward orientation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies physical carriage followed by leader, reading, blindness, lostness, and path; I infer a deliberate distinction between material and moral navigation. The live alternative is that the route language is only conventional moral diction with no reflection on the ship.
structural_cues: 17:70-72 moves from being carried on land and sea to group leadership, records, blindness, and a lost path.

activation_trace.role: Gentle driving supplies stable motion through the conventionally unstable domain.
The broad open sea supplies the mobile domain made usable by divine action.
Strengthening and fixing supplies the divine act that prevents inward displacement.
Leaning and settling toward another supplies the nearly induced directional deviation.
Agitation that shakes stability supplies hostile propulsion aimed at uprooting.
Clinging to and being weighted toward earth supplies the expected fixed domain from which expulsion is attempted.
Passage to the outside supplies forced displacement from land.
A running, followed way supplies recurrence and rule beneath apparent geographical instability.

changed_reading.after: Neither land nor sea guarantees stability: merciful governance can steady movement on water and moral position on land, while hostile force can unsettle either.
changed_reading.before: Mercy protects travelers from an unstable sea while land remains the natural place of stability.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later pressure seeks to induce a slight lean and then shake the addressee out of the land, while the focus depicts gentle carriage through mobile water. Stability is reassigned from terrain to divine action: land can be destabilized and sea can be made traversable.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gentle sea motion, divine fixing, slight leaning, agitation, earth, expulsion, and a recurring way; I infer a spatial reversal in which stability belongs to governance rather than terrain. The alternative keeps moral firmness and geographical movement as unrelated images.
structural_cues: 17:73-77 moves from attempted textual substitution to slight leaning, divine stabilization, attempted expulsion from land, and an unchanged recurring way.

activation_trace.role: Managing days with little supplies the lower threshold of the provision scale.
Remainder beyond need supplies the upper, surplus end of the scale.
Food that meets need supplies the sufficiency threshold immediately before the voyage.
Nourishing sustenance supplies the allotted base from which further seeking can proceed.

changed_reading.after: فضل is the surplus horizon of a mercy-economy that first keeps limited means viable and supplies enough nourishment for purposeful seeking.
changed_reading.before: فضل denotes an undifferentiated quantity of wealth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's branch-level movement from getting by on little toward surplus is bracketed by sufficiency in 17:65 and nourishing allotment in 17:70. Provision forms a scale from enough to sustain motion, through active seeking, to excess received as favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lexical images of sufficiency, subsistence on little, nourishing provision, and surplus; I arrange them as a scale. The live alternative is that these are independent senses whose economic sequence is reader-imposed.
structural_cues: The focus lies between كَفَىٰ in 17:65 and explicit provision in 17:70, while its own purpose clause moves toward فضل.

remaining_uncertainties: The rival-logistics reading may be a reader-supplied organization of a broader allegiance contrast.
The moral-navigation and land/sea reversal models depend on cross-domain sequencing rather than explicit comparison.
The master-mariner, womb-carriage, little-to-surplus, and recurrent-circuit readings are branch-distant and should not displace the direct ship, sea, bounty, and mercy senses.
strongest_changes: The pre-focus adversarial campaign turns gentle ship-driving into one of two rival mobilization systems: preserving enablement toward real bounty versus agitation toward deceptive promise.
The repeated sea in 17:67-69 makes routine conveyance, rescue, destructive reversal, and ingratitude one field, so mercy names a selected manner of motion rather than intrinsic maritime safety.
17:70 nests human seeking inside prior honor, carriage, allotment, good provision, and preference, preserving agency while showing that agency itself is carried.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah became a compact mechanics of mercy: governance controls motion without erasing human seeking. Its branch inventories also exposed unusually coherent nautical, gestational, sufficiency-to-surplus, and recurrent-circuit resonances that remain useful when explicitly contained.

activation_trace.role: The chief of sailors supplies a remote but exact nautical image for coordinated command of the voyage.
Gentle driving supplies the command's enacted motion.
The ship supplies the branch image's immediate material setting.
Sea-riding supplies the human activity coordinated under the master-mariner resonance.
The preserving manager supplies contextual support for command as care rather than mere rank.

changed_reading.after: The title briefly acquires a contained master-mariner resonance: sovereignty is pictured as skilled, preserving coordination of a voyage.
changed_reading.before: Lordship remains an abstract theological title placed before a transport example.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The master-of-sailors branch is unusually specific and must remain a governing analogy, not a lexical replacement of the divine title; it remains live because رَّبُّكُم, gentle driving, ship, and sea co-occur, and 17:65 adds the preserving agent. Downstream prose should mark it as a nautical resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ

activation_trace.role: The womb as a protected place of growth supplies the outlier's enclosing mercy image.
The vessel supplies the containing carrier that bears vulnerable life through another medium.
The surrounding water supplies the enveloping and hazardous medium crossed by the carrier.
Inward carrying and pregnancy supply contextual activation for reading carriage as protected gestation.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy takes material form as womb-like carriage: vulnerable people are enclosed, borne, and developed while passing through a surrounding danger.
changed_reading.before: Mercy is an affective disposition attached to transport.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The رحم-as-womb image is cross-domain and should not be asserted as the noun's direct sense in رَحِيمًا; it remains anchored by the mercy root, a containing ship, water, and the nearby branch of inward carrying. Downstream prose should present it only as a protective gestational analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ ... إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًا

activation_trace.role: Circularity and rotation supply a recurrent rather than merely point-to-point shape for the voyage.
Surplus and remainder supply the yield returned by repeated circuits of seeking.
Return after departure explicitly supplies renewed entry into the sea domain.
A recurring time supplies the repeated instance within the movement cycle.
A running, followed way supplies patterned recurrence beyond a single trip.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the voyage participates in a recurrent provision circuit of departure, return, seeking, and yielded remainder under a stable governing way.
changed_reading.before: The focus depicts one linear voyage toward one gain.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The circular and celestial branches of فلك exceed the immediate ship sense, so the result should remain a secondary pattern rather than cosmological exegesis; repeated return to sea and the later recurring way keep a circuit reading anchored. Downstream prose should qualify it as a formal resonance of recurrence.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ ... لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mercy is the gentle propulsion that makes risky seeking possible.** `ز ج و:B001/B003` gently drives and gets by with little, `ف ل ك:B001/B003` joins round turning with ship, `ب ح ر:B001/B002` wide abundance, `ب غ ي:B001` seeks, and `ر ح م:B001` tends. I infer controlled propulsion carries finite agents across an abundant unstable medium toward bounty. Mercy reads materially as enabled movement, not only affect.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:70 repeats carriage across both land and sea and names it honor. The later summary made the ship's propulsion here one instance of a larger dignity-through-dependence mechanism.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Mercy as controlled propulsion through exposure.** Lexical evidence: `ز ج و B001` (gently driving or pushing along) in `يُزْجِى`, `ف ل ك B003` (ship moving upon water) in `ٱلْفُلْكَ`, `ب ح ر B005` (open exposure) in `ٱلْبَحْرِ`, `ب غ ي B001` (seeking and pursuing) in `لِتَبْتَغُوا۟`, and `ر ح م B001` (mercy and tenderness) in `رَحِيمًا`. Structural cue: 17:64 presents hostile mobilization and 17:65 protective custody; 17:67–69 makes the medium's danger explicit, while 17:70 repeats human carrying over sea and land. Assigned role: gentle driving makes movement possible, exposure keeps it vulnerable, and seeking converts transport into access to bounty. Abductive move: the ayah calls the arrangement mercy; I infer that mercy works here by enabling purposeful motion through, not removal of, danger. Reading change: the ship is a mercy mechanism that couples controlled propulsion with livelihood in an exposed environment.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 17:67–69 made the exposure unmistakable, and 17:70's repeated carrying confirmed retrospectively that mercy lies in enabled passage through danger rather than abolition of danger.

words.gloss_range: your Lord, with possessive address and governing care active in the local frame
words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكُمُ}} ({{tr:rabbukumu}}) opens with a singular Lord bound to the plural addressees, so the sea scene starts as a relation before it becomes a maritime action. The root range of managing and nurturing makes the later ship-driving read as enacted Lordship, while the opening also looks forward to the closing mercy frame. Same-surah rows at 17:8 and 17:25 and the boundary from 17:65 sharpen this: the title carries care-language and turns the previous guardian theme into visible provision.
words.root_gloss_range: owning, managing, nurturing, and bringing to completion; the local noun selects Lordship as addressed care

topics.headline: possessive Lordship addresses the audience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with the addressees' own Lord, not with ships or the sea.
topics.reason: The singular construct noun with a plural suffix is locally supported as the nominative anchor and gives the opening title a direct audience relation.

topics.headline: identity frames the following action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that divine identity is placed before the motion, making the action a disclosure of who the Lord is.
topics.reason: The nominal opening and following relative construction license the claim that the ship-driving clause defines or identifies the opening subject.

topics.headline: Lordship carries managed care
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Lordship here joins authority to sustaining management, while the local noun remains a title rather than a separate verb of raising.
topics.reason: The root family supports owner-manager-nurturer pressure, but local grammar selects the title {{ar:رَبُّكُمُ}} ({{tr:rabbukumu}}), not an explicit verbal process.

topics.headline: Lordship links protection, provision, and mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening title is a hinge between prior protection, present provision, and the ayah's closing mercy.
topics.reason: Rows with concrete Surah 17 anchors at 17:8, 17:25, and 17:65 and the opening-to-closing echo inside 17:66 cohere with the ayah's structure and are not contradicted by the local parse.

words.gloss_range: the one who; definite relative linking the Lord to the following action
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِى}} ({{tr:alladhī}}) fastens the opening Lord to the action that follows. Its singular masculine agreement keeps the relative clause attached to the Lord rather than to the plural addressees, and its definite relative force makes the ship-driving a defining disclosure rather than a loose description.

topics.headline: relative agreement locks the antecedent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the next action is grammatically tied to the Lord, not to the human audience.
topics.reason: Agreement and attachment evidence force the relative to modify or predicate the singular opening title.

topics.headline: the relative clause defines through action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah defines Lordship through a sustained act of provision.
topics.reason: The relative clause extends through the action and purpose frame, so the connector has real discourse payoff even without lexical root content.

words.gloss_range: He causes to move or drives gently onward, locally with the ship as object and humans as beneficiaries
